correctness.rationale: For any fully specified continuous iid null and n>=1, the uniform transform writes W² and A² as quadratic empirical-process forms. The diagonal functions q_W(u)=u²-u+1/3 and q_A(u)=-1-log[u(1-u)] have covariance 1/18, while integrated squared Brownian-bridge kernel with the AD weight is 1/18. Hoeffding diagonal/degenerate pair decomposition gives Cov(W²,A²)=1/(18n)+2(n-1)/(18n)=(2n-1)/(18n); analogous integrals give (4n-3)/(180n) and [10-6n+(2n-3)π²/3]/n. Endpoint integrals finite; n=1 consistent. Independent high-precision integration of Cov(q_W,q_A)=1/18 and K-integral=1/18 confirms critical constants. Analytic identities, not finite n tests, prove universal n.
